name: Morphi Robot
summary:
Morphi Robot, operated by Shenzhen Moqi Intelligent Technology, develops humanoid hardware and embodied AI as an integrated system. Its research combines foundation models, data collection and methods for transferring learned capabilities across environments. The core architecture connects generation, understanding and decision-making.

The company aims to support autonomous movement, physical manipulation and natural interaction through a common development stack. Its long-term product direction is household assistance, with robot experience feeding back into model and system improvements. Morphi's work therefore spans both the physical robot and the data and learning infrastructure needed to make behavior useful beyond a controlled laboratory setting.
